before: In-flow tables always started below floating tables, text frames before a table anchored after it, and several positioned-table rules differed.
after: In-flow tables stand beside floats and frames that leave room, and positioned tables follow the corrected alignment, admission, and keep-whole rules. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree, and saved documents keep the same XML.
